rules.action: Submits the query (or the highlighted suggestion).
Closes suggestions if open; otherwise clears the field. On an already-empty field with no list open it does nothing and fires no onClear.
Opens suggestions and highlights the first; then moves down.
Moves up; from the first, back to the input with no highlight.
Leaves the field: to the clear button when the field has text, then the submit button.
